records.name: Extra Counter
records.description: Capacity | +1 initial shop slot.

records.name: Second Look
records.description: Control | One free reroll per preparation, only unsold unreserved slots.

records.name: Hold That Offer
records.description: Control | Reserve one unsold offer against rerolls this preparation; release or buy it normally. Does not carry across attempts.

records.name: Haggler
records.description: Discount | Each completed reroll gives eligible newly rolled ordinary standard packs a +15 percentage-point chance of a 1-coin discount, capped at 45% this preparation; reset next attempt.

records.name: Fresh Delivery
records.description: Control | +1 free reroll per preparation, separate finite charge.

records.name: Paid Search
records.description: Control | After free charges are used, allow up to two paid rerolls per preparation at 1 coin each; no free stock restoration.

records.name: First Purchase
records.description: Discount | First purchased ordinary standard pack each preparation costs 1 coin less, floor 1. Nonstacking with other offer discounts.

records.name: Marked Down
records.description: Discount | Eligible advanced products have a 20% chance of a 1-coin discount on creation; floor 1, not stackable with other discounts.

records.name: Bulk Bargain
records.description: Discount | One eligible booster box, Golden or mixed bundle per preparation may receive a guaranteed 1-coin discount on first eligible appearance; no stacking with other discounts.

records.name: Hirelings
records.description: Product | Enable guaranteed individual hero offers from currently eligible pack pools; retain approved relative class prices; Uncommon/Legendary values unresolved.

records.name: Contract Board
records.description: Control | Reserve one initial unsold slot for an eligible individual hero offer when possible; affordable opening guarantee takes priority.

records.name: Double Contract
records.description: Product | Unlock a product containing two guaranteed copies of the offered hero; provisional price max(2,2× individual price−1), each copy rolls its skin independently.

records.name: Triple Contract
records.description: Product | Unlock a product containing three guaranteed copies of the offered hero; provisional price max(3,3× individual price−1), independent skins.

records.name: Crate Dealer
records.description: Product | Enable booster-box offers, provisionally three normal packs of one eligible tier at 3× its standard pack price−1 (minimum 3 after discounts); normal independent hero and skin rolls.

records.name: Gilded Seal
records.description: Product | Enable Golden/Shiny full-roster offer: all three distinct eligible heroes from one pack; selected price 3× standard pack price, minimum 3; each skin rolls independently.

records.name: Crossroads Trade
records.description: Product | Enable mixed product containing two standard packs of two different currently accessible tiers; proposed price sum of their ordinary pack prices−1, minimum 2.

records.name: Hidden Compartment
records.description: Bonus pack | Once per preparation, first purchased eligible non-Recruit standard pack has a 25% chance to include one bonus ordinary Recruit pack. Bonus does not consume stock or recursively grant another; original pack still draws exactly one hero.

records.name: Larger Stall
records.description: Capacity | +1 additional initial shop slot.

records.name: Curated Shelf
records.description: Control | Reserve one initial slot for an unlocked eligible advanced product (individual, bulk, booster, Golden or mixed); affordable opening guarantee takes priority, normal stock fallback if none eligible.

records.name: Personal Commission
records.description: Control | Before initial stock generation choose one eligible discovered hero class as commission target; one initial individual offer guarantees that class if possible, using the existing individual price. No guaranteed skin or free hero; affordable guarantee takes priority and only one commission per preparation.
